svg.title: AI-Powered Personal Financial Assistant: five-day Mamba-2 forecasts, FinBERT sentiment, Monte Carlo risk and portfolio optimization behind one chat interface
svg.desc: AI-Powered Personal Financial Assistant: five-day Mamba-2 forecasts, FinBERT sentiment, Monte Carlo risk and portfolio optimization behind one chat interface

g.text: Co-developed a full-stack decision-support platform that unifies five-day
Mamba-2 forecasts, FinBERT sentiment, Monte Carlo risk and portfolio
optimization behind one chat interface. Financial math stays in tested Python
services; the language model orchestrates and explains.
